handoff: Approve: the open-pr guard meets AC1-AC3. Review#1's blocking finding is fixed: the integration tests now run real ticks while waiting at merge, for AC3 and the spec-folder-only check. Still a minor note: the guard covers only merge-bound gates (ready, merge); the person should confirm in the PR.

findings.title: The guard covers merge-bound gates only (carried over from review#1)
findings.detail:
AC1 and AC2 say 'a gate or a merge step'. mergeBoundSteps limits the guard to merge steps and to gates with a path to merge or $done that avoids open-pr. Read literally, AC1 would refuse the shipped story workflow at human-qa, and AC1 also says the shipped workflows must validate. The narrower reading follows the slice Goal. It is a scope decision for the person to confirm.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: No code change. State the reading in the PR body.
